question: Why is the one who is both all-encompassing and fruitless still worthy of reverent salutation as a giver of benefit?
premises: The addressed entity is described as all-encompassing.
The same entity is described as fruitless.
Despite this, the entity is called a giver of benefit.
inference: Therefore the speaker offers reverent salutation to that paradoxical benefactor.
plain_english: I bow to that one who is all, yet fruitless, and who indeed gives benefit.
